human_metrics.reason: project owner directed all human review to the end of candidate construction

next_gate: execute the consolidated human shadow-review wave, qualified adjudication, and project-owner dispositions; any scheduling or fan-in requires a separate ADR
observed_harness_lessons: Strict schemas and evidence-reference validation constrain structure; they do not provide semantic approval.
Protected focus-profile material kept overlapping roles distinguishable while a shared universal envelope preserved harness interoperability.
Static configuration consistently required configured_not_demonstrated or not_assessed effectiveness.
Synthesis-sensitive roles can consume content-addressed child candidates while preserving child identifiers and unknowns.
Transport and package completeness must be tested before inference; fail-closed regressions caught a missing pyproject.toml before model execution.
Raw model payloads must remain separate from deterministic projection, locators, lifecycle controls, and human packets.
Credentials can be streamed without retention; all retrieved Increment 5-7 evidence had zero exact-key and restricted-marker matches.

timing_limitations: Comparable per-role latency was not retained across every wave.
The Increment 5-7 remote command took 512.3 seconds including transfer, regression, inference, packaging, and hashing; it is not a pure model-latency measurement.
No A100 timing or throughput claim is inferred from GX-10 execution.
